claims.text: The evaluation metrics used include BLEU, NIST, METEOR, ROUGE-L, and CIDEr.
The word error rate (WER) was used to measure the accuracy of the generated text against corrected variants, with specific percentages reported.
The model was evaluated on event level using gold standard event selection, comparing generated descriptions to existing reference texts.
